svg.title: Capsule letter plate — L (LASER)
svg.desc: Direction A (scale the world-space glyph up): today's letter language redrawn for minification. Ink border, hot-magenta face, one slab letter at stroke 22/128 (3.1 screen px on the shipped 18.2px face) and cap height 92/128 = GLYPH_INK_FILL 0.72 exactly. No rivets and no chamfer: T-015 measured both gone at FAR. Rectangles, not text, so the raster does not depend on an installed font.
